info.name: mealJiNode
info.description: MealJi auth, people, kitchens, location, and service radius. Local OTP is 123456 while FIXED_OTP is set. Demo phones: customer 9000000031, super admin 9000000001, platform subadmin 9000000002, Koramangala kitchen admin 9000000011, kitchen subadmin 9000000012, Indiranagar kitchen admin 9000000021. Customer flow: Login, Verify OTP, then Update current location (one call: saves the GPS point and returns data.serviceability with the chosen kitchen, ETA, fees, isOpenNow and the alternatives in range; stores {{servingKitchenId}}), then home and menu without a kitchenId. Console flow: Staff login with staffPhone, Verify OTP, then Admin or Kitchen desk. A point outside every active kitchen radius returns 200 Not serviceable.

request.description: Liveness check. No authentication.
Public. 200 when MongoDB is reachable, 503 otherwise. Also reports redis and queues status.
Prometheus metrics. Needs `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>` when METRICS_TOKEN is set; open in development without a token, disabled in production without one.

Customer sign-in. Creates the account when the phone is new. Name is optional. Then call Verify OTP with 123456 while FIXED_OTP is set. Saves userId. Response: userId, otpSent, otpLength, expiresInSec, resendAfterSec. Within the resend cooldown (45 s) no new SMS is sent (otpSent: false) and the code already sent still works. Suspended accounts get 403.

Console sign-in. Uses staffPhone. Default 9000000001 is the super admin. Subadmin 9000000002. Koramangala kitchen admin 9000000011, subadmin 9000000012. Indiranagar kitchen admin 9000000021. Does not create an account. Then Verify OTP with 123456. Response: userId, otpSent, otpLength, expiresInSec, resendAfterSec. Within the resend cooldown (45 s) no new SMS is sent (otpSent: false) and the code already sent still works. Suspended accounts get 403.
Resend OTP for the saved userId. 429 while the 45 s cooldown from the last code (from any send path) is running. Local code stays 123456 while FIXED_OTP is set.

Verify OTP. The device id (x-device-id header, or deviceId in the body) is required and checked before the code is used, and must match later refresh calls. Local otp is 123456. Saves accessToken and refreshToken. Response also includes isNewUser (first sign-in ever), profileComplete and user. After 20 wrong codes in 24 h the account is locked out of OTP sign-in until the next day (429).

Rotate the refresh token. Header x-device-id must be the same value used at verify. The token is read from the refreshToken cookie first, then the body, then the x-refresh-token header (Postman's cookie jar usually sends the cookie). Replace both saved tokens with the new accessToken, refreshToken, and expiresIn. Fails after the account is suspended or its phone number changes.
Revoke the current access token and this device's refresh token. Requires the bearer access token.
Current user, role, permission keys, and subscription snapshot.
Public. App versions, maintenance mode, feature switches and support contacts set by the admin (settings key `app`), plus server time and business timezone. Cached 60 s.

request.description:
Authenticated. The one call the app makes for location: send the GPS point; the backend saves it (and looks up the address text with Google Maps when GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set) and returns data.serviceability in the same response.

Kitchen choice (all on the backend): every active kitchen whose service radius covers the point is found, nearest first. The nearest one that can take orders now (open and accepting orders) is chosen; if none can, the nearest one is chosen and isOpenNow is false. The other kitchens in range are listed in data.serviceability.alternatives (for a Switch kitchen option: send ?kitchenId= on menu calls).

The status is 200 either way; read data.serviceability.serviceable. Outside every radius: serviceable false, kitchen null, and the point is logged as demand.

Sample point 12.9568, 77.6349 lies between Indiranagar and Koramangala (both 3 km radius), so both cover it. The test script stores the chosen kitchen in {{servingKitchenId}}.

response.name: Serviceable (two kitchens in range)

request.description: Authenticated. Returns the saved textual location.

Authenticated. Optional: Update current location already returns the same result. Use this to re-check without saving: it uses these coordinates, or the saved location when latitude and longitude are omitted. Same kitchen choice as Update current location (nearest kitchen that can order now, else nearest), with data.alternatives listing the other kitchens in range. Inside a radius the message is Serviceable and data.kitchen is set; outside every radius the status is still 200, the message is Not serviceable, and data.kitchen is null.

Requires kitchen.desk and kitchen.settings. This kitchen's overrides and the effective values inherited from city and platform.

item.name: Settings

request.description: Requires settings.read. Every setting group with its fields, types, limits, defaults and the permission needed to edit it.

Requires settings.read. Optional scopeType (global | city | kitchen) and scopeId (city name or kitchen ID). Returns stored values at that scope, effective values with inheritance, the source of each value, scheduled versions and history.

Requires settings.read plus the group's permission (settings.app / settings.policies). `values` is a patch: only the listed fields change; null removes an override. A reason is required when a money field changes. Optional effectiveFrom (ISO, future) schedules the change; scheduled changes are independent, so a later immediate change never brings a scheduled one forward.
Requires settings.read plus the group's permission. Cancels one version that has not taken effect yet; other scheduled versions stay as they are. 409 if it is already in effect.
